title: OpenAI signs a USD 38bn multi-year cloud computing deal with Amazon Web Services
summary: The agreement gives OpenAI access to AWS data centres and Nvidia GPUs and follows the end of Microsoft's exclusive cloud rights.

title: India's IT ministry releases AI Governance Guidelines, a principles-based framework instead of a new AI law
summary: MeitY published guiding principles and an action plan under the IndiaAI Mission, saying existing laws can cover most AI risks for now.

title: Moonshot AI releases open-source Kimi K2 Thinking reasoning model and reports leading scores on some agentic benchmarks
summary: Moonshot AI published the weights of Kimi K2 Thinking, a long-horizon reasoning and tool-use model, and cited its own benchmark results.

title: Anthropic says a group it assesses as Chinese state-sponsored used Claude Code to automate most of an espionage campaign
summary: Anthropic reported that attackers used Claude Code to run an intrusion campaign against about 30 organisations with little human input; it says it banned the accounts and notified victims.

title: Alibaba opens a public beta of its free Qwen consumer AI app in China
summary: Alibaba launched the Qwen app, built on its Qwen3 models, as a free AI assistant for consumers.

title: Microsoft and Nvidia to invest up to USD 15bn in Anthropic, which commits USD 30bn to Azure compute
summary: Anthropic also agreed to use up to one gigawatt of Nvidia systems, in a deal that values the company at about USD 350bn according to press reports.

title: Google releases Gemini 3, its newest flagship model, with a Deep Think mode to follow after safety testing
summary: Google released Gemini 3 Pro across the Gemini app, Search and developer tools and said the Deep Think variant would arrive later after further safety evaluation.

title: European Commission proposes delaying AI Act high-risk obligations to 2027 in its Digital Omnibus
summary: The proposal ties the start of high-risk requirements to the availability of standards and needs approval from Parliament and Council.

title: US Commerce Department authorises Nvidia chip exports to G42 in the UAE and Humain in Saudi Arabia, reported at up to 70,000 chips
summary: The licences cover advanced Blackwell-class chips for two Gulf AI firms, with security conditions attached, according to press reports.

title: French prosecutors widen probe into X's Grok chatbot after posts questioning Holocaust gas chambers
summary: Paris authorities added Grok's French-language posts to an existing investigation into X, according to Spanish and French press.

title: Trump signs 'Genesis Mission' order to apply AI to federal science data and national-laboratory computing
summary: The order directs the Department of Energy to build an AI platform for scientific research using federal datasets and supercomputers.

title: South Korea's President Lee proposes a 2026 AI budget of KRW 10.1tn, more than triple this year's, incl. 15,000 more GPUs
summary: In his budget speech Lee set out AI spending within a KRW 728tn budget, covering GPUs, physical AI and training 11,000 AI specialists.

title: SoftBank Group says it sold its entire Nvidia stake for about USD 5.8bn to help fund its OpenAI investment
summary: SoftBank disclosed it sold 32.1m Nvidia shares in October and said it must sell holdings to fund more than USD 30bn committed to OpenAI.

title: Baidu releases Ernie 5.0, a natively omni-modal model it says performs at a globally leading level
summary: Robin Li unveiled Ernie 5.0 at Baidu World 2025, citing multimodal understanding, writing and agent planning.

title: Putin calls for an AI 'headquarters' with binding powers and domestic control over all AI stages, favouring soft-law regulation
summary: At AI Journey 2025 Putin set AI adoption reporting by March 2026, a GDP contribution goal above RUB 11tn by 2030 and wider experimental legal regimes.

title: Musk says xAI will work with HUMAIN and Nvidia on a 500 MW data centre in Saudi Arabia, first phase 50 MW
summary: Announced at the US-Saudi Investment Forum, Nvidia's Huang described xAI as a major new customer for HUMAIN's data centre.

title: UAE launches a USD 1bn 'AI for Development' initiative for digital infrastructure in Africa at the G20 summit
summary: Announced during the G20 leaders' summit in Johannesburg, the initiative aims to fund AI and digital infrastructure across African countries.
